answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 860 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. A ivory of doubt is healthy, a cedar of proof is required, and a mirror of patience is the price of a clean panel.
